limitations: Observation-catalog target coordinates are a pointing proxy. The wide cone and independent detector geometry are required. Missing catalog coordinates, offset pointings, HRC, gratings and CC mode limit coverage. Aperture counts use only supported dither/GTI bins. The 95% limit applies to mean detected aperture rate in those bins, without a PSF, vignetting or bad-pixel correction. Raw single-visit excess probabilities include chance excesses and diffuse emission. CSC matches are positional alternatives. A CSC per-observation photometry row can be a weak or forced measurement.
